subject: AP format, invoice issuer & portal service-account onboarding
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Brennan <laura.brennan@stellara.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AP format, invoice issuer & portal service-account onboarding

Hi Laura,

Quick one from our AP coordination queue — we're getting Stellara's onboarding ready and I want to confirm two things so our invoices meet your AP system requirements:

1) Invoice originator: do you want invoices to come from "billing@redwood.com" (PDF attached) or should they be created in the Stellara portal (preferred for your team) and email copies delivered to accounting@stellara.com? We can support either; portal-only helps with automation but some buyers still insist on a PDF email copy.

2) Attachment formats: your AP note requested a per-line VAT/tax breakdown and PO matching pattern (STL-YYYY-#####). Can you confirm whether you need an embedded CSV payload in addition to the PDF (we can attach both) or if a detailed PDF is sufficient?

If portal is ok, we can create a read-only service account (API token) scoped to invoice-read and webhook delivery so your downstream system can ingest invoices automatically. We'll need the email for the service account and an admin contact for the setup.

I've attached a sample invoice template so you can flag any line-level changes.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Laura Brennan <laura.brennan@stellara.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <accounting@stellara.com>
Date: 2025-05-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AP format, invoice issuer & portal service-account onboarding

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the context — portal-first is definitely our preference. A few specifics:

- Portal creation + email copy to accounting@stellara.com works best. Our ERP will pull the PDF from email when webhook ingestion isn't available.
- We require a line-level VAT column (rate + amount) visible on the invoice PDF. The PO format is as you noted: STL-YYYY-#####. If the PO is present in the invoice subject line and in the invoice body, that's perfect.
- CSV: not strictly required every time, but we ask that you include a machine-readable CSV once per billing month containing all invoices for that month. A single compressed CSV monthly file is fine.

Attached is our AP requirements doc and an example PO.

For the service account: please provision a token scoped to invoice:read and webhook:create. The service account email should be invoices@redwood-stellara-bot.com. Our admin is Molly Chang (molly.chang@stellara.com).

Laura
AP Director
Stellara Therapeutics

Attachment: stellara_ap_requirements.pdf

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Brennan <laura.brennan@stellara.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-03T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AP format, invoice issuer & portal service-account onboarding

Laura — appreciate the detail. We're happy to accommodate portal-first + email copy. Operational notes:

- We'll enable a portal service account: invoices@redwood-stellara-bot.com and generate a scoped API token. I'll route the token to Molly via a secure Doc link (DocuSign/One-time secret link) once you confirm the admin contact.
- For the first two billing cycles, we'll also send email PDF copies to accounting@stellara.com as a fallback while you validate webhook ingestion.
- We can include a monthly compressed CSV (one file) uploaded to your SFTP or posted to your webhook depending on preference. Which would you prefer for the monthly CSV delivery?
- Sample invoice (attached) uses a clear VAT_rate/VAT_amount line and includes PO in subject and line items. If you have any field-level variance, flag them and we'll update the generation template.

Next steps: Laura to confirm CSV delivery method (SFTP vs webhook) and Molly to accept the secure token link. We'll target the token provisioning and fallback emails within 48 hours of confirmation.

Cheers,
Marissa
Senior Billing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_sample_invoice_v2.pdf

---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Brennan <laura.brennan@stellara.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-04T14:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AP format, invoice issuer & portal service-account onboarding

Hi Laura — quick confirmation from my side:

- Stella: CSV delivery to SFTP endpoint is preferable for most of our accounts; we'll stand up the CSV to SFTP job and drop a readme alongside the monthly file. If you'd rather webhook, we can switch later.
- We'll provision the service account token today and send a one-time secure link to Molly. Token will be scoped to invoice:read, webhook:create and set to rotate after 90 days.
- Fallback: PDF emails to accounting@stellara.com for May and June only.

I'll create the onboarding ticket and attach the SFTP details to the Doc link. Expect the secure token link in the next 2–4 hours.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

--- End of thread ---
